name: LLMoin
use: AI text and research assistant for about 40,000 Hamburg public administration staff. It summarizes content, drafts texts and searches documents, and other German states have adopted it.

name: FastwebMIIA
use: Italian-trained large language model for businesses and the Italian public administration. It runs on infrastructure located in Italy.

name: Albert
use: The French state's generative AI, used by public agents (for example in France Services offices) and offered as an API to public projects.

name: Apertus
company: ETH Zurich, EPFL and Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS)
use: Switzerland's fully open multilingual large language model, released in September 2025. It is available via Hugging Face and Swisscom.

name: C'LIA
use: Generative voice AI that answers the city switchboard in the evenings and at weekends. It went live in February 2025.

name: ChatPaT
use: Virtual assistant that helps citizens and businesses find provincial public services. It answers 24/7 in six languages from the official services catalogue.

name: Agrippina
use: Generative AI chatbot on the city website that gives residents direct answers about city services and information.

name: Muckl
use: Chatbot on stadt.muenchen.de that answers residents' questions about city administration. Its scope has grown since a test phase before the elections.

name: Emma
use: AI assistant in Gelsenkirchen's citizen service that receives and handles requests by phone, email and chat.

name: Sofia
use: AI virtual assistant on the municipal website that answers 24/7 by text or voice, in several languages. It helps with office hours, procedures and documents.

name: Maia
use: AI shopping assistant in the Knuspr online supermarket that helps customers with their grocery shopping.

name: Alfie
use: AI shopping assistant for the Austrian online supermarket. It creates recipes, plans weekly menus and recommends products.

name: Frag Mich
company: Neue Pressegesellschaft (Südwest Presse, Märkische Oderzeitung, Lausitzer Rundschau)
use: AI article chat in the newspaper apps that answers subscribers' questions using only the papers' own editorial content.

name: Iris
use: AI virtual tutor that gives computer science students hints on programming exercises instead of full solutions.

name: Syntea
company: IU International University of Applied Sciences
use: AI learning assistant that answers students' questions from course materials. It also creates quizzes and runs exam simulations.

name: GPT.UP
use: University AI chat assistant that gives students and staff access to several language models for research, teaching and everyday tasks.
